description:
Decode dependency-shape assertion configuration, including its target selector, when rules load.

## Background

Graph assertions `LabelCoverage`, `LabelReference` and `DependencyShape` hold raw `toml::value::Table` payloads (`crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:577-590,923-927`), and evaluation reads their keys on each call, so a malformed rule surfaces only during evaluation. Typed `Raw*` structs lowered at load are the existing pattern (`rules.rs:940-1089`), and `RuleConfigError::InvalidAssertion` names the rule. Rule serialization renders the tables with `render_config_table` (`repository_state/rule_serialize.rs:267-275,366-396`). The dependency-shape `target` becomes a `Selector` only at evaluation (`validation/graph.rs:1380-1393`), so an invalid state token in it never meets selector validation, and `test_dependency_shape_missing_target_is_config_error` (`graph.rs:3146`) reaches evaluation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `DependencyShape` holds a typed configuration with its mode as an enum and a validated `Selector` parsed at load.
- [hard] REQ-02: A malformed dependency-shape assertion, including an invalid state token in its target, fails rule loading with an error naming the rule.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rule serialization emits the same keys for a typed dependency-shape assertion.
title: Dependency-shape assertions are typed at load
